content.title: Met Office: UK Seasons Changing with Fewer Winter Frosts and More Hot Summer Days
content.caption: The Met Office reports that the UK's seasons are shifting with fewer winter frosts and more hot summer days, affecting wildlife, agriculture, and weather patterns.
